LEGAL DESCRIPTION

ALL that (those) certain lot(s), tract(s) or parcel(s) of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden, and State of New Jersey, and is bounded and described as follows:

PARCEL A:

BEGINNING in the Northwesterly line of Euclid Avenue 80 feet Southwesterly from the Westerly corner of Euclid Avenue and Tumley Avenue; thence Southwesterly along the Northwesterly line of Euclid Avenue 80 feet in width or breadth; thence Northwesterly between parallel lines, parallel with Tumley Avenue 142 feet in length of depth.

PARCEL B:

BEGINNING a point in the boundary line of premises owned by the party of the first part which beginning point is located on the Northerly line of Euclid Avenue, distant 160 feet Westerly along said line from its intersection with the Westerly line of Tumley Avenue; and extends thence

1.  Westerly along said Northerly line of Euclid Avenue the distance of 10 feet to a point; and extends thence
2.  Northwardly parallel with the Westerly line of Tumley Avenue making an interior angle of 89 degrees, 43 minutes 30 seconds with the preceding course the distance of 142 feet to a point and extends thence
3.  Eastwardly parallel with the first course the distance of 10 feet to an angle in the boundary line of property of the party of the first part; and extends thence
4.  Southwardly parallel with the second course along party of the first parts said boundary line the distance of 142 feet to the point of BEGINNING.

FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY:  BEING known as Tax Lot 3.01, in Tax Block 129, on the Official Tax Map of the Borough of Haddonfield.

FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY:  The mailing address is:  15 East Euclid Avenue, Haddonfield, New Jersey 08033.
